observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR body with a telephoto zoom lens mounted on a McSteve Gadget Store box.
Photo 1 shows the lens barrel marked Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR 70-300mm f/4.5-6.3G ED VR.
Photo 2 shows scuffed wear on the camera handgrip and Nikon branding on the pentaprism.
No photo shows the camera powering on, the shutter firing, the rear screen, or the sensor.

claims.evidence: Nikon brand is readable in photos 0, 1, and 2; the D3400 model number is not legible in any photo

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: photos cannot show camera function, shutter operation, autofocus, or sensor condition

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or the shutter may be faulty
risks.proof: video of the camera turning on and the shutter firing

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, haze, or element separation
risks.proof: close-up of front and rear lens elements under light

risks.risk: Autofocus or vibration reduction may not work
risks.proof: video of autofocus hunting and VR engaging

risks.risk: Sensor may have dust or dead pixels
risks.proof: photo of a plain wall shot at small aperture

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or dead
risks.proof: photo of the battery and charger with the camera powering on
risks.if_unproven: as sold without working battery or charger

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and the shutter firing
Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements under light
Video demonstrating autofocus and vibration reduction
Photo of a plain wall shot at small aperture to reveal sensor condition
Photo of the battery and charger included
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Nikon DSLR with a 70-300mm lens from the photos; because function cannot be verified remotely, it is priced at its worst case as not working.
